digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter layer — rich-text encoding abstraction
propositions: Cloud uses ADF (JSON document) while Data Center uses plain text/wiki markup, requiring codec abstraction to unify the outbound mapping path

RichTextCodec Protocol defines four operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) to preserve load-bearing composition order and behavior differences in existing Cloud callers
AdfCodec (Cloud) must wrap adapters/jira/adf.py with no reimplementation and reside in adapters/jira/ to maintain import-contract boundary; WikiTextCodec resides in adapters/jira_family/

map_fields_to_remote must exist in exactly one real implementation under adapters/jira_family/ taking RichTextCodec as constructor dependency, with all Cloud and DC call sites re-pointed atomically in the same change
WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT and truncation marker must be named module constants with sourced comments; truncated values must not exceed the limit and must end with the marker
